annotation_description: Playing Mountain over Multiversal Passage when holding a blue-heavy hand (Winternight Stories, Quantum Riddler, Duelist of the Mind all need blue). With only 2 blue sources (Spirebluff Canal, Steam Vents), adding a third blue source via Passage as Island would improve mana consistency. Since it's postcombat main with nothing else to cast, Passage could enter tapped for free (no life payment needed).

Duelist of the Mind enters as essentially a 1/3 (one card drawn this turn from draw step) which is not very threatening. Warping Quantum Riddler for the same 1U mana cost would have provided a 4/6 flying body for one attack (4 damage against an empty board), drawn a card on ETB, and set up the Riddler to be cast from exile on a future turn.

Duelist of the Mind is a 1/3 with flying and vigilance. Opponent's only flyer (Clarion Conqueror) is tapped, and Sarkhan can't block flyers. Attacking deals 1 free damage with zero risk since vigilance keeps it untapped for defense.

Cast Nova Hellkite for its Warp cost ({2}{R}) instead of its full cost ({3}{R}{R}), even though 5 mana was available (4 lands + Treasure Token). Warp means the creature gets exiled at the beginning of the next end step, losing a permanent 4/5 flying threat for no reason.

message: Select a nonland permanent an opponent controls
annotation_description: Bouncing the Fish Token (a 1/1 creature) instead of the Treasure Token, which provides mana acceleration and serves as bargain fodder for cards like Torch the Tower. Both are tokens that cease to exist when bounced, but the Treasure represents significantly more value.

Sonnet Stoic passed the turn with 5 mana available and multiple strong plays in hand. At 11 life facing an aggressive board (Tiger-Seal 3/3, Duelist of the Mind, Fear of Missing Out with delirium likely active), deploying threats or answers was critical. Clarion Conqueror (3/3 flyer for 2W that shuts down activated abilities) could have been cast, or Sarkhan + behold a Dragon (revealing Nova Hellkite) to create a Treasure token and start building a board presence. The reasoning mentions a failed Warp cast of Nova Hellkite but then passes without casting anything else, wasting the entire turn's mana.

Chose to return Torch the Tower from graveyard when the opponent has no meaningful creatures to target (only two 1/1 Fish tokens). Winternight Stories would draw 3 cards and help find burn/threats to close out the game against an opponent at 11 life with an empty board.
